~ Late July / Early August 2023 *(exact date not stated in article)*

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical observation: YES *(1953 temperature record, previous Salta min record)*
T2. Forward-looking immediate: YES *(typhoon landfall Sunday, fire risk near-term)*
T3. Long-term development: YES *(El Niño trajectory, escalating fire season)*

**Synopsis:**
Canada is experiencing a severe wildfire crisis with 900+ active fires burning ~3M hectares, with smoke reaching northern Europe. Argentina's Salta city recorded an unprecedented winter overnight minimum of 26°C, driven by an intensified Foehn/Zonda effect, likely amplified by the developing El Niño. That same El Niño is also fuelling heightened typhoon activity in the western Pacific, with Tropical Storm Noul forecast to make landfall on China's southeast coast as a Category 1 typhoon.
